items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Art Blakey was really instrumental in me actually developing into a jazz musician in terms of my mentality. He challenged every preconception I had about the music

ctx.x: Well, I didn’t …I was…I didn’t have a conception of beauty. I was fifteen. Fifteen year olds don’t have any conception of beauty, man. They just don’t. I don’t know what it is. And, occasionally, Shostakovich did, when he was fifteen, but that’s…. That’s an isolated thing. It’s very unusual, very unusual. But, yeah they were nice solos. My dad was playing the records for me. But I learned a couple, just cause, you know, if you can’t do it, then you should try to do it…try to learn it. But it was still no idea…I…
